jobs.description: At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. CesiumAstro is expanding its global footprint with the establishment of a new office in Munich, Germany. We are looking to add a Senior Manager of Talent Acquisition to the team who will play a critical leadership role in building and supporting this next phase of CesiumAstro’s growth in Europe. In this position, you will lead talent acquisition efforts for CesiumAstro’s Munich office, developing and executing the recruiting strategy required to build the organization from the ground up. The Senior Manager will partner closely with leadership, human resources, and functional leaders to translate business and workforce plans into an effective hiring strategy for Germany and the broader European talent market. JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Partner with U.S. based Talent Acquisition and Human Resources leadership to align European hiring activities, processes, and operating standards with CesiumAstro’s broader talent strategy. Build, lead, and develop a high-performing recruiting team to support rapid growth in Munich and broader European hiring needs. Lead full-cycle recruiting for critical positions, including specialized engineering, technical, operations, and business roles. Develop targeted sourcing strategies and talent pipelines across Europe for highly specialized professionals in aerospace, satellite communications, RF systems, electronics, embedded systems, hardware, software, and related disciplines. jobs.title: Senior People Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations. Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data. As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI. The Team and Your Impact Hi, I'm Gio , and I lead People & Culture at Qdrant. I joined in April 2026 to build the People function from scratch. We have laid the foundations: went live with Ashby and with a new HRIS, launched our first engagement survey, a leveling framework, and our first review and compensation cycles are coming in 2027. Our colleagues are spread across about 30 countries, and our People team is small by design. We need systems that scale as Qdrant does. As our Senior People Operations Engineer, you’ll build how People Ops runs, write the policies behind it, and automate every process that doesn’t need a human touch. You don't need "People Operations Engineer" in your title to apply. If you are an HR generalist who automates everything, or an HR systems person who has handled multi-country cases, we want to hear from you. What you will own About 60% of your time goes to running People Ops, and about 40% to building. The mix will shift with what the business needs. jobs.description: The Talent Acquisition Team at Agile Robots is looking for a Working Student (m/f/d) Talent Acquisition . We are seeking a student with first relevant professional experience and a curious interest in robotics and AI. Responsibilities End-to-End Recruiting: Own the full hiring process for your own set of roles, such as working student and intern positions, from the role briefing through screening to the signed contract, in collaboration with a Talent Acquisition Manager. Sourcing Support: Search for and approach candidates for open positions across the team through LinkedIn, job boards and university channels. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
jobs.description: Talent Acquisition ist für uns mehr als Recruiting. Wir verstehen es als eine echte Disziplin, die sich stetig weiterentwickelt durch neue Technologien, neue Ansätze und vor allem durch die Menschen, die sie gestalten. Dabei zählt für uns nicht nur das Ergebnis, sondern auch der Weg dorthin. Und genau diesen Anspruch wollen wir mit dir weiterentwickeln. Als Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders) übernimmst du die End-to-end-Verantwortung für deine Hiring-Prozesse und arbeitest eng mit unserem Talent-Team zusammen. Du bringst deine Persönlichkeit und deine Werte ein und hast gleichzeitig den Raum, neue Ideen auszuprobieren und Recruiting aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei unterstützt dich ein modernes, AI-gestütztes Setup mit Ashby als ATS, Metaview als AI-Notetaker sowie Claude, Notion und Gemini. Die Technologie nimmt dir dabei nicht das Recruiting ab, sie gibt dir mehr Raum für das, worauf es wirklich ankommt: Menschen zu verstehen, die richtigen Talente zu gewinnen und gemeinsam die besten Matches zu schaffen. What to expect End-to-end Recruiting : Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess, vom Hiring Kick-off und Talent Mapping bis hin zur Vertragsunterzeichnung Sparring Partner : Du bist ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Hiring Manager, forderst sie heraus und trägst durch deine Marktkenntnisse zur Entscheidungsfindung bei Pipeline Building : Du sprichst gezielt Talente über verschiedene Kanäle an und baust nachhaltige Talentpools durch Active Sourcing und Employer Branding Initiativen auf Data & Analytics : Deine Pipeline baust du basierend auf fundierten Daten und nutzt diese auch aktiv in der Hiring Manager Beratung Candidate Champion : Du optimierst gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Prozesse und leitest eigene OKR-Projekte, um unsere Candidate Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern Inspire us by Background : Abgeschlossenes Studium und ca. 2 - 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting von Business-Rollen in einem dynamischen Umfeld Expertise : Sehr
